name: Olimpbet
note: Russian bookmaker; the brand operates in Russia through ООО "БК "Олимп" (olimp.bet, FNS licence of 2012). Three-year SKA deal from 2025-26 puts its logo on helmets and jersey sleeves (Sports.ru, 21 Oct 2025); also partner of CSKA, Dynamo Moscow, Spartak, Severstal, Sochi, Amur, Admiral, Neftekhimik. Lead: Stavka TV's bookmaker guide (checked 1 Oct 2026) says ООО "Зевс" holds 97.5% and CEO Sergei Kozyavkin 2.5% — affiliate media, needs confirming against the ЕГРЮЛ register before any rating; no state link found. Stays unrated.
